author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮಾಡಿರುವ ಕರ್ಮಗಳ ಫಲವುಣ್ಣಲೇಬೇಕು
ಬೇಡಿದರು ಕೊಡದಿರವು ಮುಕ್ತಿ ನಿನಗೆಂದು
ಕಾಡುವವು ಸಿಹಿಕಹಿಯ ನೆನಪುಗಳು ಬಿಡದಂತೆ
ನೋಡು ನಿನ್ನನೆ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You must taste the fruit of the deeds you have done;
even if you beg, they won’t grant you release;
memories sweet and bitter will haunt you without letting go;
look at your own self, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We cannot escape the results of our actions, however much we plead. Memories, sweet and bitter, follow us. The answer is honest self-examination.
